```python
temp = "hello=good="
parts = temp.split('=', 1)   # split only at the first '='

```

`str.split(sep, maxsplit)` splits the string at most `maxsplit` times. By passing `1`, we split only at the first `"="`, leaving the rest of the string (including any trailing `"="`) intact in the second element.
